data.logic_flow_gate: Report no flow while the pump is off

data_description.logic_flow_gate: The flow sensor cannot measure below 5 l/min and reports exactly 5.0 with the pump stopped. With this on, the flow reads 0 whenever the water pump is off, which also removes the phantom thermal power computed from it. The raw register value stays available as `flow_rate_raw`.
data_description.experimental_registers: Adds read-only sensors for 18 registers the device answers on but the manual does not document. Nothing is ever written to them. Meant for collecting data over time.
data_description.flush_pulse_lead_seconds: How early the “before a flush pulse” trigger fires. The unit ramps up over about 50 seconds, which is too short to react to — the default of 180 s leaves time to write to the machine first.
